title: ZE0 OSM build profile (version 2)
description: A build profile states WHAT goes into a ZE0 card image, not how it is encoded. Profiles are whole-tile only: a profile selects complete BxxRyyR tiles, and the border buffer extends the tile search and the routing graph but never clips tile contents (docs/research/build-profiles.md, decision 2026-11-05). Version 1 profiles (the four files in profiles/*.json as of 2026-11-05) are accepted by tools/profile_validate.py through a documented legacy adapter; new profiles MUST use version 2. Validation is implemented without third-party packages: tools/profile_validate.py interprets the keyword subset listed in its SUPPORTED_KEYWORDS constant and fails loudly on any keyword it does not understand.

version.description: Profile format version. Version 1 is the pre-2026-11-05 shape with include/detail/routing.

name.description: Stable machine name, also the default output stem.

description.description: Human-readable purpose. Say when the delivered tiles extend past the region, because whole tiles can include neighbouring regions.

sources.description: Geofabrik/bbbike extract names the builder may read (provenance only; the validator never opens them).

border_buffer_deg.description: Border buffer in latitude degrees (1 deg lat = 111.32 km). tools/profile_validate.py widens the tile search by dividing the longitude padding by cos(mid-latitude), so the buffer is roughly isotropic on the ground.

bbox.description: [west, south, east, north] in WGS84 degrees, not GeoJSON order.

countries.description: ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 codes, provenance only; bbox is authoritative.

default.description: id of the tier used when no tier region matches a tile.

region.description: Optional coverage area of this tier. Omitted = the profile region. Tiers are tried in array order; the first match wins.

roads.description: 'all' = every drivable highway class, 'core' = motorway..secondary, 'none' = do not load road geometry, or an explicit OSM highway class list.

mode.description: Only whole tiles are supported. Sub-tile clipping is not implemented and is not planned until the format and the unit prove it (docs/research/build-profiles.md).

include.description: Explicit tile ids. Non-empty means exactly these tiles (minus exclude); empty means derive from region + border bracket.

location.description: Where the ODbL attribution ships. 'card-file' still needs a manifest check (docs/research/build-profiles.md, Attribution).
